commands.command: git clone https://github.com/oobabooga/textgen && cd textgen && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements/portable/requirements.txt --upgrade && python server.py --portable --api --auto-launch
conda create -n textgen python=3.13 && conda activate textgen && git clone https://github.com/oobabooga/textgen && cd textgen && pip install -r requirements/full/requirements.txt && python server.py

note: Commands were taken from a summarized fetch of the README; the conda line is joined from separate steps and the requirements file is the NVIDIA one.
